summary: Intrusion Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a warrant inducement program approved by its board on August 14, 2026, running through August 28, 2026. During the period, holders exercised 1,660,954 existing warrants at a reduced exercise price of $0.795 per share (including $0.125 for a New Warrant), generating aggregate gross proceeds of $1,320,458. For each exercised warrant, the company issued a New Warrant with a $0.67 exercise price and a five-year term. The offering relied on Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b) exemptions. The transaction is an equity capital raise structured as a warrant inducement; watch future dilution from the new warrants and potential overhang on the stock.
